scope: Exact project/route and owning predicate/source-target observations for all182retained emitted records. This is contextual evidence, not automatic semantic disposition or one-to-one source-to-emission matching. Duplicate names/targets across contexts remain visible; only exact diagnostic indices witness configured warnings.
counting: Records retain original reported Swagger identities. warningIndices index the entire original configured source diagnostic array in each source capture. Several records/contexts may witness one warning; distinct warning records are not collapsed by position.
